headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI driving margins.
summary: TCS posted ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, the highest margin in the sector. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit top‑line growth, while L&T Technology Services and Wipro also grew above 9%. AI revenue is expanding rapidly, highlighted by HCLTech’s 78% YoY AI growth and TCS’s $3.1 bn AI run‑rate. Several peers (Infosys, OFSS, Mphasis) have not yet released results, adding uncertainty.
